item.title: Girl whose hoodie got trapped in a chairlift mechanism dies of her injuries
item.description: "Her sweet bubbly spirit and love for those around her will live on," her parents said in a statement days after the Outaouais ski hill incident.

item.title: Todd: Tom Wilson's thuggery a black mark for Canada's hockey team
item.description: Best our country has to offer also on display at the Olympics, with Mikaël Kingsbury soaring and Macklin Celebrini showing off his skill.

item.title: 15 kilos of cocaine, cash and guns seized in raids on Hells Angels affiliate
item.description: The raids, conducted in various parts of Quebec and New Brunswick, also netted silver ingots and methamphetamine tablets.

item.title: SAAQclic management lied to the Quebec government for years, commission concludes
item.description: The report is careful about not blaming anyone in particular for the bungled operation. Premier François Legault emerges unscathed.

item.title: Not all urine is created equally, McGill engineering study shows
item.description: Higher concentrations of urine improve clean-energy generation, Montreal researchers have discovered.

item.title: Cowan: Canadiens' Joe Veleno goes back to his elementary-school roots
item.description: Habs forward takes advantage of Olympic break to visit with students and teachers at East Hill Elementary School in Rivière-des-Prairies.

item.title: No prison time for Montreal brothers who left woman's body on couch for six months
item.description: Francesco Sansalone receives a conditional sentence involving house arrest and community service, and Nicodemo Sansalone is sentenced to three years of probation for his role in covering up the death of Alasie Tukkiapik, 41.

item.title: SAAQclic scandal: Lies, missed warnings and a $500-million cost blowout
item.description: Public inquiry finds the auto insurance board mismanaged its IT overhaul and that the premier’s office knew costs were escalating long before the public did.

item.title: Supreme Court to hear appeal over redrawing of Quebec's electoral map
item.description: The National Assembly's move to delay the redrawing to save a Gaspé riding was struck down by Quebec's Court of Appeal.

item.title: Two children hospitalized after being hit by car in Montreal West
item.description: The intersection outside a high school has been the subject of complaints that it should have a crossing guard.
